two_phase.title: Two-phase streaming conversion
two_phase.description: Keeps memory bounded regardless of dataset size. Recommended.

cell_chunk_size.title: Cells per chunk (phase 1)
cell_chunk_size.description: Affects phase-1 streaming only; does not appear in the output layout.

var_chunk_size.title: Genes per chunk
var_chunk_size.description: One gene per chunk means a single-gene fetch reads exactly one chunk.

shard_size.title: Genes per shard
shard_size.description: Zarr v3 sharding. Larger shards mean fewer objects in S3.

normalize.title: Normalize and log1p
normalize.description: Applies scanpy normalize_total + log1p. Two-phase only.

n_top_genes.title: Filter to top N highly variable genes
n_top_genes.description: Leave blank to keep all genes.

add_layers.title: Layers to add
add_layers.description: Comma-separated layer names. Each runs as its own parallel task. Leave blank for none. Every other key (X, obs, var, obsm, obsp, uns) is written by the conversion itself.

atomic_axes.title: Atomic axes
atomic_axes.description: Comma-separated obs column names. Leave blank to skip building strata entirely.

coarse.title: Coarse tables
coarse.description: Semicolon-separated specs; each spec is one column or a comma-separated list. Example: cell_type;cell_type,treatment

max_atomic_cardinality.title: Maximum atomic cardinality
max_atomic_cardinality.description: Reject the build above this many atomic strata. Default 50000.

prepare.title: Prepare a raw merge before conversion
prepare.description: Embeds and annotates the input (HVG, PCA, neighbors, UMAP, Leiden, site/patient/TCR labels). Outputs are published under prepared/.

h5ad_name.title: Input h5ad file name
h5ad_name.description: Which .h5ad in the input dataset to prepare. Used only when preparation is on.

library_column.title: Library column
library_column.description: obs column identifying the sequencing library.

site_regex.title: Site regex
site_regex.description: Applied to the library column to extract the site.

patient_regex.title: Patient regex
patient_regex.description: Applied to the library column; capture group 1 is the patient number.

tcr_column.title: TCR column
tcr_column.description: obs column marking TCR matches. Leave blank to skip tcr_status.
